name: Fashion Island
summary: This outdoor shopping mall with water features has popular retailers, restaurants & a cinema.
description: Fashion Island is an upscale outdoor shopping destination in Newport Beach featuring luxury retailers, fine dining restaurants, and a movie theater. This premier lifestyle center offers a sophisticated shopping experience with nightly tree lighting ceremonies, personal shopping services, and dazzling holiday displays throughout the year.
demographics: Fashion Island attracts an affluent demographic from Orange County's coastal communities, with visitors typically in the 35-65 age range and household incomes exceeding $150,000. The primary trade area encompasses Newport Beach, Corona del Mar, and surrounding wealthy beach communities, drawing educated professionals, retirees, and families who value premium brands and upscale experiences. Shoppers exhibit preferences for luxury goods, designer fashion, fine dining, and entertainment, with typical visits combining retail therapy with social dining experiences. The center serves as a destination for both daily convenience and special occasion shopping for Orange County's most prosperous residents.
